summary: Tested NEW POST /api/sucursal endpoint + full Sucursal CRUD + auth/users regression. CRITICAL BUG: POST /api/sucursal returns HTTP 500 (NotNullViolationError on column id) because the Postgres "Control" table has manually assigned alphanumeric IDs (A101, A102...) with no SERIAL/IDENTITY/DEFAULT, and the INSERT in server.py line 545 does not supply id. The frontend UI is fully wired (modal, form, validation, data-testids) and shows toast 'Error al crear sucursal' as expected. Auth, GET /control, GET /stats, GET /status/all, GET /status/stats, user CRUD, admin role enforcement, PUT/DELETE on existing sucursales (via test_06 forbidden check), and 404 on missing id all PASS. 12/17 backend tests pass; 5 failures all stem from the single root cause (create fails -> dependent tests cannot run).

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error. asyncpg.exceptions.NotNullViolationError: 'null value in column "id" of relation "Control" violates not-null constraint'. The INSERT does not provide id and the column has no DEFAULT/SEQUENCE.

minor.issue: Return 403 instead of 401 when no Authorization header is supplied (FastAPI HTTPBearer default). Acceptable but non-standard.
Behavior with ids like 'A999' is consistent (404 because cast/match fails), but errors are not normalized. Consider explicit handling.

action_items: FIX POST /api/sucursal id generation. Options: (a) ALTER TABLE "Control" ALTER COLUMN id ADD GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (won't work if existing values are alphanumeric like 'A101'). (b) Compute next id in the endpoint (e.g., SELECT 'A' || (MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(id FROM 2) AS INT)) + 1) FROM "Control" WHERE id ~ '^A[0-9]+$'). (c) Change schema to use UUID and supply uuid.uuid4() in INSERT. (d) Accept id from SucursalCreate payload and add to frontend form. Recommend option (b) to keep existing 'A###' convention or option (c) for cleaner schema.
After fix, also verify duplicate serie_dvr returns 400 (currently 500 because id error fires first).
Optional: normalize 401 vs 403 for missing Authorization header.

rca of the issue: RCA: The Postgres "Control" table has primary key column 'id' VARCHAR/TEXT NOT NULL with no DEFAULT or SEQUENCE attached. Existing rows use manual values like 'A101'. The new endpoint create_sucursal (server.py:533) executes INSERT INTO "Control" (empresa, sucursal, region, serie_dvr, ...) VALUES (...) without providing id, causing asyncpg.exceptions.NotNullViolationError. Reproduction: POST /api/sucursal with valid admin token + body {empresa, sucursal} -> 500. Mitigation: generate id in backend (next 'A###' or UUID) before INSERT, or add an IDENTITY/SEQUENCE to the column.
